title: Release quest-cli 0.14.2 paired with lore-cli 0.14.2 (ODOC-556)
description: Release cut for the ODOC-556 fixes (QCLI-543, QCLI-545): a patch, 0.14.2, paired with lore-cli 0.14.2 (Article 3). Leader decision. Follows docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md. Before planning the order, measure the publish parity gate with --require: this repo's memory is that quest's publish refuses until lore-cli main reads the same version, whereas the brief said lore's parity reads quest-cli main; the gate decides, not either recollection. Registry steps (staging, latest) are the operator's own dialog, tier 3; no grant or relay moves them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The metadata PR lands as two commits: the version strings first, then the binary bytes (runbook: What a version bump touches)
The pre-tag gates pass: bun run check:packages and bun run test:packages, the qualification record, and the CHANGELOG has a ## 0.14.2 heading carried by the tagged commit
Tag v0.14.2 is pushed (check the grants and the leader's ruling first) and prepublication-qualification is dispatched against that tag and produces the native-execution receipt for that exact commit
Step 6 rechecks are done (registry name and conflicts, repository identity, lore release gate, package metadata) and the release.yml dry run (publish=false) passes
Staging under release-candidate is the operator's own dialog, tier 3, and is done only after that grant; bun run receipt:verify-published passes against the staged versions
latest moves only on the leader's go, after opum-cli-e2e's pair receipt, as the operator's own dialog, tier 3

implementationNotes: Context for the verdict note that follows: Opus reviewer unit quest-cli-review-547 (DEC-183 Stage 1, model verified MATCH, relayed by the leader 2026-10-31). #706 landed as squash 002f53ba6ecb5543ab7305841d2e30f060b67791 on origin/dev; origin/main unchanged at 0f2a3422. Findings 4 and 5 are the leader to route; no action taken here.

VERDICT: APPROVE opum-ai/quest-cli#706 at head 5a3064b59dae5ced158479b74c39e29b996609af
1. Version parity holds (non-blocking): every listed file reads 0.14.2 (package.json:3 + six optionalDependencies, six npm/quest-*/package.json:3, .claude-plugin/plugin.json:3, src/application/version.ts:19, src/contract/tracker/index.ts:23, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json:3, bun.lock:21-26, CLAUDE.md:892); the six questPlatformPackages sha256 values match each npm/quest-*/package.json questBinarySha256. Every remaining 0.14.1 is history, not a declaration.
2. Contract versions unchanged (non-blocking): contractVersion/fixtureVersion 1, TRACKER_CONTRACT_VERSION (contract/tracker/index.ts:7) and CONTRACT_VERSION (cli/main.ts:176) unchanged; no behaviour change hidden in the bump.
3. CLAUDE.md (non-blocking): only the version number on line 892, inside the managed block (:889-:897).
4. CHANGELOG well formed (non-blocking): empty `## Unreleased` at :11, `## 0.14.2` at :13. Departs from docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md:229-231 ("Not part of the bump commit", rename at tag time), defensibly; the runbook prose now disagrees with practice, and a CHANGELOG entry landing on dev after this merge but before the tag would sit under Unreleased though it ships in 0.14.2.
5. Behaviour change at a patch number (non-blocking; routing is the leader's): CHANGELOG:70-84 says an existing Codex-only or Antigravity workspace's `quest agents --check` goes from green to exit 6 (Codex now the default target, writing .agents/). No `(breaking)` heading in 0.14.2, so breaking_bump passes. Content came from earlier merged PRs; worth asking once whether QCLI-328's rule should have covered it.
6. lore-check.yml consistent (non-blocking): only the npm pin :200, version mentions :135-144/:202/:205, and LORE_SOURCE_REF :148; clone/checkout/build and the :245-257 assertion unchanged; lore-pin-staleness.mjs:57 still matches. If lore-cli#702's branch is deleted before 0.14.2 reaches npm, the source path fails at `cat-file -e` (:215); QCLI-550 covers it.
7. .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md (non-blocking): exactly one added line at :70, `cache`.
Named limits: binary bytes not verifiable by reading (only the six hashes agree); dff81a03 being #702's head not confirmable by the unit; SKILL.md line not confirmable as lore's actual output; no quest agents --check or lore check run (no shell).
